services.desc: The Black Belt World Burlington Team has an incredible After School Program with decades of experience providing families in the community with a convenient way to maximize the potential of children. Our After School Program takes a harmonious approach to develop the mind, body and spirit of each individual child. Black Belt World Burlington provides extended child care services for working parents before and/or after school. The unavoidable demanding and busy work life of working parents leave gaps of unsupervised activity where children may pick-up bad behaviors and habits.
